title_en: Certain Magnesia Carbon Bricks from China, initiation of circumvention inquiry
title_ja: 中国産マグネシア・カーボンれんがの迂回調査開始 官報掲載前版
original_text:
This document is scheduled to be published in the
                                    Federal Register on 2026-11-10 and available online at
                                                                                  BILLING CODE: 3510-DS-P
                                    https://www.federalregister.gov/d/2026-22943, and on
                                    https://govinfo.gov

DEPARTMENT OF COMMERCE

International Trade Administration

[A-570-954, C-570-955]

Certain Magnesia Carbon Bricks from the People’s Republic of China: Initiation of
Circumvention Inquiry on the Antidumping and Countervailing Duty Orders

AGENCY:          Enforcement and Compliance, International Trade Administration, Department of
                 Commerce.

SUMMARY: In response to a request from the Magnesia Carbon Bricks Fair Trade Committee

(the Committee) (the requester), the U.S. Department of Commerce (Commerce) is initiating a

country-wide circumvention inquiry to determine whether imports of certain refractory bricks

containing alumina in an amount greater than zero but less than five percent by weight (bricks

with trace alumina) from the People’s Republic of China (China) are circumventing the

antidumping duty (AD) and countervailing duty (CVD) orders on certain magnesia carbon bricks

(Bricks) from China.

DATES: Applicable [INSERT DATE OF PUBLICATION IN THE FEDERAL REGISTER].
translation_ja:
## PDF 1頁（抜粋）

米商務省国際貿易局。マグネシア・カーボンれんが公正貿易委員会の申請を受け、中国からのアルミナ含有量が重量比0％超5％未満の特定耐火れんがについて、既存の反ダンピング・相殺関税命令を迂回しているかを中国全体について調査する。適用日は連邦官報掲載日。掲載前版の予定日は米国日付2026年11月10日。
facts_ja: 中国産耐火れんがのうちアルミナ含有量が重量比0％超5％未満の対象品の迂回調査を開始。対象品全般に新しい税率を決定した段階ではない。
